name: Game Idea Engine
purpose: Generate, score, rank, and gate small Roblox entertainment experiments before build effort is spent.
decision_rule: Generate many candidates, score deterministically, reject hard-fail ideas, then send only the highest-scoring buildable candidates to the Game Factory.
hard_reject: Requires paid infrastructure or paid user acquisition to prove the core loop
Copies a specific existing Roblox game, branding, or distinctive protected identity
Relies on misleading metadata, fake rewards, or deceptive monetization
Core loop is not understandable or playable in a small prototype
High safety, moderation, legal, or platform-risk burden without a clear mitigation
Cannot produce a meaningful first-play experience quickly enough for an experiment
